skills.detail:
Begin charging by holding down the skill button. If enemy attacks while charging, your Element will change to the Element you are strong against of either Red Element, Blue Element, or Green Element, just once. Your Element will not change if attacked by a Light or Dark Element enemy. Reduces damage received from enemies. If you let go of the skill button before the charge has completed, the charge will cancel and you will attack normally. If the charge has finished, you will unleash a different attack. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.

Not Charged: A long-range multiple hit charge attack. Increases damage dealt when your HP is below a certain amount.

Charged: Increases own DEF. A long-range multiple hit charge attack. Increases damage dealt when your HP is below a certain amount.
